usage.finalMessage:
I've implemented CLIN-23-R1 and committed it: `prescribe` now refuses doses above the drug's formulary maximum, accepts doses equal to it, and refuses drugs that aren't in the formulary. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes all 7 tests, including the extra acceptance tests I added.
CLIN-23-R2 isn't done and can't be done by me: Pharmacy has to verify the program's maximum doses against `docs/formulary.md` and record that in `docs/verification/`, so CLIN-23 isn't complete until they do. I made two assumptions, which are logged as open questions for Pharmacy: drug names must match the formulary exactly (so "Ibuprofen" is refused), and prescriptions already in a loaded state are not re-checked.
The report is in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
